description: This file defines internal structures and functions for handling JSON field serialization, including parsing struct tags, managing struct fields, and handling inlined fields within Go structs in the context of JSON serialization.

classes.name: structFields
classes.description: Holds metadata about the fields of a struct, including flattened list, mappings by name, and fallback inlined fields.

classes.name: structField
classes.description: Represents a single field within a struct, including its type, index, options, and functions for zero and empty checks.

classes.name: fieldOptions
classes.description: Holds options parsed from struct tags, such as name, inline, unknown, omitempty, etc.

methods.name: makeStructFields
methods.description: Constructs a structFields object by analyzing the fields of a given reflect.Type, handling inlined fields, conflicts, and sorting.

methods.name: parseFieldOptions
methods.description: Parses the `json` struct tag to extract options and field name, returning a structured fieldOptions object.

methods.name: consumeTagOption
methods.description: Parses a single tag option string, handling identifiers and single-quoted strings.
